title: Claude Code Git Worktree Setup: Run Multiple Agents in Parallel
summary: Practical setup for running parallel Claude Code agents with git worktrees, symlinked secrets and per-worktree databases.

assertions.quote: they're all pointing at the same directory. Same files, same git state, same database

verdicts.note: Shared files and databases cause collisions; worktrees or containers per agent are the standard approach, and Codex and Claude apps build this in.
